title: Proctor Fellow in Values Engagement (FiVE)
bio: Welcome to Harvard! My name is Gustavo and I’m excited to meet you. I’m a doctoral student (EdLD) at the Harvard Graduate School of Education (HGSE). HGSE is also where I earned a Master’s degree in Human Development and Psychology. Previously, I founded two education companies and led one non-profit. I am originally from California and really enjoy living in Cambridge. During my free time, you can catch me riding my bike, my long board, or at the gym. I also enjoy watching plays, trying new hobbies, and making new friends (my classmates). I look forward to introducing you to Harvard life!
